arts.ttl: Champions League LIVE: Updates from all nine of Tuesday's fixtures
arts.sum: Chelsea host Barcelona in tonight’s Champions League showpiece, with Man City welcoming Leverkusen and Newcastle facing Marseille. Arsenal-Bayern build-up features Arteta’s Ødegaard hopes.
